slot.brief: Statement-based MCQ: what happens to capacitance, charge and field when a dielectric slab is inserted in an isolated vs battery-connected capacitor.

stem: A dielectric of constant $K>1$ completely fills the gap of a parallel-plate capacitor. The plates remain fixed. Which set of statements is correct? I. Capacitance increases in either case. II. With the battery disconnected, charge stays constant and field decreases. III. With the battery connected, charge increases and field stays constant. IV. With the battery disconnected, voltage stays constant.

verdicts.working: With fixed plate separation, inserting the dielectric increases capacitance. Disconnected: charge is constant, so field decreases. Connected: voltage and field are constant, while charge increases. Hence I, II, III are true; IV is false.

working:
$C=KC_0$ in either case. Isolated: $Q=Q_0$, so $E=Q/(Cd)=E_0/K$ and $V=V_0/K$. Battery connected: $V=V_0$, so $E=V_0/d=E_0$ and $Q=CV_0=KQ_0$. Hence I, II and III are correct.

Independent check: With fixed plate separation, inserting the dielectric increases capacitance. Disconnected: charge is constant, so field decreases. Connected: voltage and field are constant, while charge increases. Hence I, II, III are true; IV is false.
